description: This file contains integration tests for the Catalog Item endpoints in the Public API of the eShopOnWeb application, verifying pagination and multiple parallel API calls.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: Test class for catalog item list paging API endpoints with various test methods.

methods.name: ReturnsFirst10CatalogItems
methods.description: Verifies that requesting the first page with pageSize=10 returns 10 catalog items.

methods.name: ReturnsCorrectCatalogItemsGivenPageIndex1
methods.description: Verifies that pagination with pageSize and pageIndex returns the expected number of items.

methods.name: SuccessFullMutipleParallelCall
methods.description: Performs 100 parallel GET requests to various endpoints and confirms all succeed with status 200 OK.
